name: float-reads-integer-items
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): float decode and ruling 3: an integer item reads as the nearest double, ties to even: 3 -> 3.0, -2 -> -2.0, 2^53+1 (1b0020000000000001) -> 2^53; float always writes a float: f94200, f9c000, fa5a000000. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
